const items=[]; const form=document.querySelector("form"); const list=document.querySelector("#list"); form?.addEventListener("submit",e=>{e.preventDefault(); const value=new FormData(form).get("item")?.toString().trim(); if(!value)return; items.push(value); list.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`
  • ${x.replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<")}
    • `).join(""); form.reset();});
questions.hint: Use `click` handlers to toggle the active tab and matching panel.

const items=[]; const form=document.querySelector("form"); const list=document.querySelector("#list"); form?.addEventListener("submit",e=>{e.preventDefault(); const value=new FormData(form).get("item")?.toString().trim(); if(!value)return; items.push(value); list.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`
  • ${x.replaceAll("&","&").replaceAll("<","<")}
